title: MIDI humanize
description: Adds a little random variation to the velocity and the start time of every note so that the music sounds played by hand. It takes notes and gives notes back.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.doc: Off passes the notes through untouched (bypass).

parameters.name: velocity
parameters.doc: How far the velocity may move up or down (1 to 127 scale).

parameters.name: timing
parameters.doc: How far the start of a note may move, in thousandths of a beat.
